_comment: sim/slew-rate as a `klt sim` request (issue #95): T1 item 5 coverage for the ratified slew-rate row.
Circuit: tb_slew.body.spice -- the same test circuit as ../testbench/tb_slew.spice.tmpl (one deliberate re-expression of the inp pwl drive; see the body's header).
Grid: cornerMOSlv.lib mos_tt/ss/ff/sf/fs [DR-1] x {-40, 27, 125} C x VDD {1.08, 1.20, 1.32} V = 45 corners.
vinp sweeps WITH vdd by index (klt's supply_v semantics), so Vcm = VDD/2 at every corner, as in the harness.
Each process corner is a bundle carrying the template's fixed cornerCAP.lib cap_typ section (the Miller cap is a cap_cmim MIM device).
Analysis: tran 1n 800n 0 0.05n = the template's T_PRINT, T_STOP, startup 0, T_MAX; `.options interp` is in the body, as in the template.
Ratified row: slew rate into CL = 2 pF >= 7.51 V/us worst-case [DR-2], the WORSE of the rising and falling edge at each point (spec/target-spec.md section 2).
Encoding of 'the worse of two edges': one measurement per edge, sr_rise_v_per_us and sr_fall_v_per_us, EACH carrying the same ratified bound min 7.51.
min(rise, fall) >= 7.51 holds if and only if rise >= 7.51 AND fall >= 7.51, so the pair passes at a corner if and only if the worse edge passes there,
and the row's verdict is the conjunction of the two measurement verdicts. No combined 'worst' value is invented: a `.meas` result is not visible to an `expr`
(checked while building #85), so the tool cannot compute min(rise, fall) itself; the worse edge at each corner is read off the two reported values.
Each edge is the time between the two crossings of the window Vcm +/- 0.15 V (0.3 V span) by the output, read on `orel = v(out) - VDD/2` so a single literal level serves every corner;
`td` confines each search to the edge under test (rise: after 250 ns, edge at 300 ns; fall: after 500 ns, edge at 550 ns), the harness's [T2,T3] / [T3,T_STOP] windows.
sr = 0.3 V / dt / 1e6 (V/us), a `.meas ... param` of the preceding time measurement (verified to evaluate in ngspice batch mode).
The *_inner_* measurements and lin_*_ratio reproduce the harness's ramp-linearity check (Vcm +/- 0.075 V window within 2% of the outer-window slew).
pre_rise_orel_v / pre_fall_orel_v reproduce its full-swing traverse check (output parked below the window just before the rising edge, above it before the falling edge).
drive_pp_v / drive_centre_err_v reproduce its drive-integrity check (inn excursion 2*0.3 V +/- 2%, centred within 10 mV of the DC output).
op_* reproduce its per-point DC sanity rule on the t = 0 (operating-point) solution: |Vout - VDD/2| <= 0.15*VDD and Vd1, Vd2, Vtail, Vout each within [0.02, 0.98]*VDD.
The *_dc_v node voltages and the t_*/inner/vinn measurements carry no limits: they are reported for compare.py's join against the harness CSV.

options.timeout_s = 300 s per corner: the harness ran the whole 45-point grid in roughly 8 minutes (about 10 s per corner, sim/slew-rate/README.md), so 300 s is ~30x headroom for the 800 ns / 0.05 ns-max-step window (>= 16000 timepoints).

klt's --fail-fast-probe applies to the local backends only; on the batch backend the per-corner timeout above is the guard, and a timed-out corner is graded error, which run.sh/compare.py refuse as evidence.
Solver tolerance: ngspice default, no .options reltol/abstol/vntol (DR-0005).
ngspice_init raises the printed digits only (measureprec for .meas, numdgt for expr); it changes no solver setting.
keep_artifacts is false so the committed envelope carries no host-absolute artifact paths; to debug a corner, run a copy of this request with it set (and --outdir outside the repo).

measurements.name: t_rise_outer_s
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_rise_outer_s trig v(orel) val=-0.15 rise=1 td=250n targ v(orel) val=0.15 rise=1 td=250n

measurements.name: t_fall_outer_s
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_fall_outer_s trig v(orel) val=0.15 fall=1 td=500n targ v(orel) val=-0.15 fall=1 td=500n

measurements.name: t_rise_inner_s
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_rise_inner_s trig v(orel) val=-0.075 rise=1 td=250n targ v(orel) val=0.075 rise=1 td=250n

measurements.name: t_fall_inner_s
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_fall_inner_s trig v(orel) val=0.075 fall=1 td=500n targ v(orel) val=-0.075 fall=1 td=500n
